meta.title: A vendor cannot price a bid belonging to another company
gaps: the plan has the buyer send POST /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}/create_bid_products, but the buyer's web-console session may not call POST /v1/bids/:id/create_bid_products (bids#create_bid_trade_products is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
